## Wave 2 Summary

Wave 2 routes the Wodzicki-BCS Bridge Theorem at registry slot `§VII.BA` (S91 W9-9 / W1-14 STAGE-1-CANDIDATE landing; audit_sha256=`fe8e0a65b1c1d06d1ac61aadb6414cca61e80834a558cbf5b57a019ea4a0df27`) toward STAGE-3-PERMANENT eligibility per `.claude/rules/joint-theorem-promotion.md` 4-stage pathway. STAGE-3-PERMANENT eligibility, if granted at S92 Wave 2 close, would make §VII.BA the framework's **THIRD cross-axis joint theorem** to reach STAGE-3-PERMANENT after (i) §VII.AH at S90 W2 CF-20 (FIRST framework cross-axis joint theorem to reach STAGE-3-PERMANENT eligibility; `joint-theorem-promotion.md §"Substrate-input-orthogonality clause"` K=3 MANDATORY trigger event) and (ii) §VII.U.2 Corner II Var_a as STAGE-3-PERMANENT-eligible candidate landing scheduled in S92 Wave 4 (per `session-92-context.md §"§VII.U.2 STAGE-3 chain"` line 217).

The Wave 2 closure chain has FOUR substantive carry-forward gates plus ONE registry retrofit downstream of the S91 W9-11 `S91-BRIDGE-MAP-SCHEME-INDEPENDENCE-AUDIT` PASS (audit_sha256=`1fef32c8f88d89f39548f0b086717b7efea8e82f3c015b73c947977f9d573f58`; Reading A confirmed `Δ_scheme = 0.000e+00 EXACTLY` at L_max ∈ {5, 12, 14}; cross-pillar-bridge-anatomy.md `Bridge-map-scheme suffix discipline` carve-out admissible at §VII.AQ.OP-PROJ per the "When structural-output-type independence IS pre-established and confirmed" clause). The 5 gates resolve, in order:

1. **§W2-1 (CF-W9-11-1, METHODOLOGY-class)** — `S92-W2-CF-W9-11-1-VII-AQ-SCHEME-SUFFIX-RETROFIT`. mack-cosmic-bridge sole-writer retrofits `sessions/permanent-results-registry.md` §VII.AQ.OP-PROJ to cite Reading A scheme-INDEPENDENCE bit-precision identity in lieu of the scheme-suffix tag on the convention field.
2. **§W2-2 (CF-W9-11-2, METHODOLOGY-class)** — `S92-W2-CF-W9-11-2-CORPUS-ROW-K2-ADVANCEMENT`. mack-cosmic-bridge sole-writer appends a calibration corpus row to `sessions/framework/registry/cross-pillar-bridge-corpus.md §10` for the Bridge-map-scheme suffix discipline K=1 → K=2 advancement on axis β.
3. **§W2-3 (CF-W9-9-1, COMPUTE-class)** — `S92-W2-CF-W9-9-1-WODZICKI-F-FUNCTOR-M-KK-5-NORMALIZATION`. connes-ncg-theorist derives the Wodzicki F-functor image-normalization scalar `[N] = [M_KK^5]` from substrate-natural dimensional analysis on `Ψ(A_K)` per Connes 1995 §III; closes §VII.BA Level-3 dimensional gap noted in S91 W9-9 §"Level-3 Empirical Anchor" line 1668 of the W9 working paper.
4. **§W2-4 (CF-W9-9-2, COMPUTE-class)** — `S92-W2-CF-W9-9-2-LEVEL-2-ENVELOPE-C-W-L-MAX-SCAN`. connes-ncg-theorist calibrates the Level-2 envelope `C_W` constant in `|Res_W(L_max=L) − Res_W(∞)| ≤ C_W · L^{-2}` via L_max-scan over L ∈ {10, 12, 14} on the master cache, OR certifies bottom-band invariance via Friedrich-Bär saturation theorem per `.claude/rules/math-scripts.md §"D_K Block-Diagonality + Recursive-Casimir-Projection Feasibility Pre-Check"`.
5. **§W2-5 (CF-W9-9-3, COMPUTE-class — Stage-2 cross-axis verify)** — `S92-W2-CF-W9-9-3-VII-BA-STAGE-2-CROSS-AXIS-VERIFY`. # ---- Verdict rubric ----
PASS_meaning: |
  All 5 predicates (a) ∧ (b) ∧ (c) ∧ (d) ∧ (e) PASS at re_read time. The §VII.AQ.OP-PROJ retrofit block is on disk
  at `sessions/permanent-results-registry.md`, cites the S91 W9-11 audit_sha256 = 1fef32c8f88d89f39548f0b086717b7efea8e82f3c015b73c947977f9d573f58
  AND the `cross-pillar-bridge-anatomy.md §"Bridge-map-scheme suffix discipline"` carve-out clause. The content_sha256 of
  the retrofit block matches the input-pin-map-derived hash computed during build_promotion_text. The registry-anchor
  layer's scheme-suffix requirement on §VII.AQ.OP-PROJ is structurally retired (carve-out clause cited; downstream consumers
  cite §VII.AQ Reading A scheme-INDEPENDENCE theorem in lieu of the suffix). Solution-space: closes a Class-8.3 audit-trail-
  staleness defect at §VII.AQ.OP-PROJ; preserves audit-trail completeness for the S91 W9-11 PASS verdict's downstream registry
  effects.

FAIL_meaning: |
  Any one of the 5 predicates returns False at re_read time. Either (a) the retrofit block is not present at re_read, OR
  (b) the citation of the S91 W9-11 audit_sha256 is absent or malformed, OR (c) the cross-pillar-bridge-anatomy.md carve-out
  citation is absent, OR (d) substantive_line_count < 15, OR (e) the content_sha256 mismatch indicates an Edit/Write race
  or an mtime conflict (per `epistemic-discipline.md §"Registry-Write Hygiene under Parallel-Writer Race"`). Solution-space:
  routes the retrofit to S93+ remediation; the §VII.AQ.OP-PROJ scheme-suffix-related audit-trail defect persists at registry
  layer; downstream consumers continue under the post-S90-W7-CF-55 Reading A confirmation status but without the registry-text-
  embedded W9-11 bit-precision strengthening.

INFO_meaning: |
  The METHODOLOGY-class gate has no INFO band — the predicate set is binary (5-conjunction PASS or FAIL). An INFO emission
  would be a Class-8.2 verifier-rubric pre-registration failure. If a partial-match condition is detected at runtime, the gate
  emits FAIL with the specific predicate(s) named in the value field.

  content: |
    Definition 1 (Wodzicki residue convergence rate on finite spectral triple): per Connes 1995 §III.4 (`Noncommutative
                  Geometry`, Academic Press 1995, Proposition 3 + Theorem 4 of §III.4), the Dixmier trace / Wodzicki residue
                  on a finite spectral triple of dimension d converges at rate `L^{-(d-2)}` to the asymptotic limit

                  line 19225), `Res_W(D_K^{-2s})|_{s=2} = Σ_{(p,q)} dim(p,q) · Σ_i |λ_(p,q),i|^{-4} · ξ_W(s=2)` where

                  cohomology-class invariant rate at the dimension-spectrum pole; the -2 exponent is determined by d=4 and
                  the Dixmier-trace truncation theorem). The pre-registered SIGN claim is `slope ≈ -2` and the magnitude
                  claim is the empirical extraction of C_W.

                  scan; ROUTE A) OR (saturation-theorem upper bound; ROUTE B).

    Conclusion:    The Level-2 algebraic envelope at §VII.BA is `|Res_W(L) − Res_W(∞)| <= C_W · L^{-2}` at d=4 per Connes 1995
                  §III.4. The C_W constant is empirically extracted via L_max-scan {10, 12, 14} OR analytically bounded via

# ---- Verdict rubric ----
PASS_meaning: |
  (ROUTE A) Log-log fit slope `slope_emp ∈ [-2.10, -1.90]` AND C_W empirical extraction returns a positive scalar with
  `|Res_W(L=12) − Res_W(L=14)| <= C_W · 12^{-2}` satisfied; OR (ROUTE B) Friedrich-Bär saturation theorem analytic argument
  certifies bottom-band invariance of Res_W(D_K^{-4}) at L_max=12 with `η_FB_lower · √(C_2(p+q=13)+1) > Res_W_bottom_band_magnitude`
  strict inequality. Solution-space: confirms the L^{-2} scaling exponent of the §VII.BA Level-2 envelope at d=4 (substrate-IS
  Wodzicki residue convergence rate per Connes 1995 §III.4); the C_W constant is pinned (ROUTE A) or analytically bounded
  (ROUTE B); §VII.BA's Level-2 envelope is structurally complete. Enables §W2-5 (CF-W9-9-3 Stage-2 cross-axis verify) to dispatch
  (CONDITIONAL on §W2-3 + §W2-4 joint PASS).

FAIL_meaning: |
  (ROUTE A) `|slope_emp − (-2.0)| > 0.5` OR negative-magnitude C_W (envelope inverted); (ROUTE B) Friedrich-Bär bound fails
  the strict inequality (bottom-band intrusion at L_max>=13 violates saturation theorem). Solution-space: the L^{-2} scaling
  exponent at d=4 is structurally PROVEN by Connes 1995 §III.4; a FAIL implies one of: (a) the substrate-IS Wodzicki residue
  evaluation does NOT enter the asymptotic regime at L_max ∈ {10, 12, 14} (boundary effects dominate); (b) the §VII.BA bridge
  theorem's Element 4 envelope identification is structurally incomplete (e.g., L^{-2} is the leading-order rate but
  subleading corrections at small L invert the empirical slope sign); (c) the master cache's eigenvalue distribution at high
  Peter-Weyl (p+q) sectors does NOT match the Connes 1995 §III.4 asymptotic assumption. Each pathway routes to S93+
  remediation. §VII.BA STAGE-3 promotion postponed pending diagnostic.

INFO_meaning: |
  (ROUTE A) `slope_emp ∈ [-3.0, -2.10] ∪ [-1.90, -1.5]` (within ~50% of analytic prediction but outside 10% PASS-band — boundary
  effects suspected); (ROUTE B) Friedrich-Bär bound satisfied with margin <2σ of the saturation threshold. Solution-space:
  Level-2 envelope partially-confirmed; the L^{-2} structural form is supported but the numerical extraction is in the boundary-
  effect regime; §W2-5 may dispatch CONDITIONAL on INFO interpretation with explicit boundary-effect acknowledgment in the
  Stage-2 cross-reviewer dispatch prompt.

  verdicts (PASS-AND aggregation), AND substrate-input-orthogonality predicate satisfied at ≥ 1 observable (here, satisfied at

  clause receives FAIL from EITHER cross-reviewer (logical OR within JOINT clause set; PASS-AND aggregation = NOT (∃ JOINT clause
  c, ∃ cross-reviewer r: r.eval(c) == FAIL)); (d) substrate-input-orthogonality predicate FAILS at all observables (e.g.,

  promotion.md §"Stage 2" FAIL criterion: "Either cross-reviewer returns FAIL on ANY clause → Stage 2 → 3 promotion blocked;
  theorem stays at Stage 1; FAILing clauses route to next-session remediation." Solution-space: §VII.BA STAGE-3-PERMANENT

INFO_meaning: |

  PASS — the N · Res_W normalization or the C_W envelope extraction yields borderline values that don't pass the

## Wave 2 → Wave 3 Decision Point

Wave 2 outputs flow to S93+ rather than to S92 W3 (which addresses Group C §VII.AV refinement-pathway + Level-2 moduli per `session-92-context.md` line 250). The Wave 2 → S93+ decision logic:

**Case A — Wave 2 closes PASS at all 5 gates (§W2-1 ∧ §W2-2 ∧ §W2-3 ∧ §W2-4 ∧ §W2-5 all PASS)**:
- §VII.BA promoted to STAGE-3-PERMANENT eligibility at S93+ via a downstream mack-cosmic-bridge sole-writer tag-flip gate (`S93+-VII-BA-STAGE-3-PERMANENT-TAG-FLIP`). The tag-flip is a METHODOLOGY-class gate (single Edit on `sessions/permanent-results-registry.md:19211` to replace `STAGE-1-CANDIDATE` with `STAGE-3-PERMANENT`); ~0.1 wave-equivalents.
- §VII.AQ.OP-PROJ scheme-suffix retrofit complete; downstream consumers of §VII.AQ cite Reading A scheme-INDEPENDENCE theorem in lieu of scheme-suffix on convention field.
- HIT K-counter at the Wodzicki-BCS pillar pair achieves K=2 → K=3 MANDATORY trigger (per `cross-pillar-bridge-anatomy.md §"Hybrid Independence Test"` K=3 MANDATORY promotion threshold per `feedback_rules-compensate-missing-structure.md`); jointly with substrate-input-orthogonality K=2 → K=3 MANDATORY trigger (the §VII.BA Stage-2 dispatch's 2-observable orthogonality satisfaction).

**Case B — Wave 2 closes FAIL at §W2-3 OR §W2-4 (Level-3 dimensional gap OR Level-2 envelope L^{-2} verification fails)**:
- §W2-5 honestly closes per `.claude/rules/mechanical-closure-discipline.md` with verdict `FAIL -- value='PRE-REG-INC_blocked_by_W2-3_FAIL'` (or `_blocked_by_W2-4_FAIL'`); the producing script EMITs ONE verdict line per the AFTER-pattern and updates the §W2-5 working-paper section.
- §VII.BA remains at STAGE-1-CANDIDATE.
- S93+ carry-forward: re-derivation of the FAILing element with refined substrate-physics derivation (M_KK^5 normalization morphism elaboration if §W2-3 FAILed; or extended L_max scan / alternative envelope form if §W2-4 FAILed).

**Case C — Wave 2 closes PASS at §W2-3 + §W2-4 but FAIL at §W2-5 (Stage-2 cross-axis verify FAIL on any JOINT clause)**:
- §VII.BA remains at STAGE-1-CANDIDATE.
- The FAILing clause is documented in the §W2-5 verdict line value field with the specific cross-reviewer (Axis-A or Axis-B) and the specific clause (Element N or Level N) identified.
- S93+ carry-forward: re-dispatch the Stage-2 verify with refined registry text addressing the FAILing clause (e.g., if Axis-A FAILed on Element 4 envelope form, re-derive the envelope per §W2-4 outcome and re-register the entry; if Axis-B FAILed on Element 2 OE-form discipline, retrofit the OE-form per `cross-pillar-bridge-anatomy.md §"Element 2 OE-form discipline"`).

**Case D — Wave 2 closes INFO at §W2-3 OR §W2-4 (borderline regime)**:
- §W2-5 dispatch CONDITIONAL on INFO interpretation; if both §W2-3 and §W2-4 return INFO with consistent substrate-physics direction (sign=PASS at both), §W2-5 may dispatch with EXPLICIT INFO-acknowledgment in the cross-reviewer dispatch prompts (cross-reviewers verify the Level-3 anchor under the INFO-band Level-3 ratio rather than the PASS-band Level-3 ratio).
- If §W2-5 returns PASS under INFO-conditional dispatch, §VII.BA Stage-3-PERMANENT eligibility is DEFERRED with Stage-2-INFO-deferred annotation per `joint-theorem-promotion.md §"Stage 2"` INFO criterion; S93+ re-verify with refined L_max scan.

**Wave 2 does NOT gate Wave 3 (Group C §VII.AV refinement-pathway)**. Wave 2 and Wave 3 are structurally independent: Wave 2 operates on the §VII.BA Wodzicki-BCS pillar pair (Pillar III pseudodifferential operator algebra ↔ Pillar V BCS gap-equation regulator-invariance); Wave 3 operates on §VII.AV refinement-pathway at Corner IV (algebra-DEPENDENT state-pair functional family). Cross-wave dependencies between W2 and W3 are NONE.
